proof_body:
by
  intro a b c d ha
  have hd : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => a * y ^ 3 + b * y ^ 2 + c * y + d) (3 * a * x ^ 2 + 2 * b * x + c) x := by
    intro x
    have h3 := (hasDerivAt_pow 3 x).const_mul a
    have h2 := (hasDerivAt_pow 2 x).const_mul b
    have h1 := (hasDerivAt_id' x).const_mul c
    exact (((h3.fun_add h2).fun_add h1).add_const d).congr_deriv (by norm_num; ring)
  constructor
  · intro hm
    have h0 : 0 ≤ deriv (fun y : ℝ => a * y ^ 3 + b * y ^ 2 + c * y + d) (-b / (3 * a)) := hm.deriv_nonneg
    rw [(hd _).deriv] at h0
    have h3a : 3 * a ≠ 0 := by positivity
    have : 3 * a * (-b / (3 * a)) ^ 2 + 2 * b * (-b / (3 * a)) + c = (3 * a * c - b ^ 2) / (3 * a) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [this] at h0
    have := (div_nonneg_iff.mp h0)
    rcases this with h | h
    · linarith [h.1]
    · linarith [h.2]
  · intro h
    apply monotone_of_deriv_nonneg (fun x => (hd x).differentiableAt)
    intro x
    rw [(hd x).deriv]
    have : 0 ≤ a * (3 * a * x ^ 2 + 2 * b * x + c) := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (3 * a * x + b)]
    exact nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right this ha
target_source: ∀ (a b c d : ℝ), 0 < a → (Monotone (fun x : ℝ => a * x ^ 3 + b * x ^ 2 + c * x + d) ↔ b ^ 2 ≤ 3 * a * c)
